newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SPURS DUO RULED OUT OF ENGLAND'S SUMMER PLANS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SPURS DUO RULED OUT OF ENGLAND'S SUMMER PLANS.

text.p: Midfielder Darren Anderton and his Tottenham team mate Ian Walker have been ruled out of England's next five matches with multiple injuries.
Anderton, who has had four major operations in the past two seasons and is currently suffering from hamstring problems, will undergo "a bio-mechanical assessment" at a clinic in Sweden.
It is hoped the results will explain why he has been plagued by injuries throughout his career.
Goalkeeper Walker, who played in England's 1-0 home defeat by Italy in February, has injuries to a shoulder and a heel and will be sidelined for six weeks.
Both players will miss England's World Cup qualifier in Poland on May 31 and a friendly against South Africa the previous weekend.
They will also miss a four-team tournament in France in June in which England face France, Italy and Brazil.
